en.headline: 8 own commits across three repos; 18 automated commits by github-actions[bot]
en.summary: Across three repositories the user made **8 own commits**, and `github-actions[bot]` also produced 18 automated commits. In `sogeisetsu/opencode-skill-management`, 5 commits tidied documentation: dropping references to a removed doc, moving plans into `.openchamber/plans`, adding a Steps checklist with corrected cross-references, normalizing line endings to LF, and revising the `skill_management` spec plus a feasibility evaluation. The 2 commits in `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu` improved AI-failure visibility and model labeling, adding a 30-day summary redesign and degrading pages to an "issue link not retrieved" state when the notifier fails. A single commit in `sogeisetsu/opencode-agent-sandbox` added an `opencode-provider` knowledge category covering catalog sources, credential ownership, endpoints, and OpenChamber governance. The only issue activity was a comment on `openchamber/openchamber` issue #4939 about text selected inside an `openchamber_render` page never opening the comment menu, which carried 2 comments in total. Two replies arrived in existing issues: `btriapitsyn` confirmed #4601's thinking-level bug was fixed in `7d037b07d`, and `yulia-ivashko` reported #4899's export-resolution bug as unreproducible. Three issues in `openchamber/openchamber` were closed by `btriapitsyn` (#4896, #4920, #4601).

zh.headline: 三个仓库共 8 次本人提交，另有 18 次 github-actions[bot] 自动提交
zh.summary: 用户在三个仓库共完成 **8 次本人提交**，此外 `github-actions[bot]` 还产生了 18 次自动提交。在 `sogeisetsu/opencode-skill-management` 中，5 次提交用于整理文档：删除对已移除文档的引用、把计划改存到 `.openchamber/plans`、补充 Steps 清单并修正交叉引用、统一换行符为 LF，以及修订 `skill_management` 规范并做可行性评测。`sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu` 的 2 次提交提升了 AI 失败的可见性与模型标注，加入 30 天总结改版，并在 notifier 失败时让页面退化为「未取到 issue 链接」。`sogeisetsu/opencode-agent-sandbox` 的 1 次提交新增了 `opencode-provider` 知识类别，涵盖 catalog 三层来源、凭据归属、端点与 OpenChamber 管辖。唯一的 issue 动态是在 `openchamber/openchamber` 的 issue #4939 上留言，内容是关于 `openchamber_render` 页面内选中文本始终不弹出评论菜单，该 issue 共有 2 条评论。另有 2 条回复出现在既有 issue 中：`btriapitsyn` 确认 #4601 的思考等级问题已在 `7d037b07d` 修复，`yulia-ivashko` 则表示 #4899 的导出分辨率问题无法复现。`openchamber/openchamber` 中有 3 个 issue 被 `btriapitsyn` 关闭（#4896、#4920、#4601）。用户还发起了讨论 #5114，建议把渲染页面选择菜单的修复拆开，先落地 frame→host 的选择桥接。
